maria: Change window ends in ~40m. Ops policy: no risky migrations after halfway point. This backfill looks risky.

alex: I agree, abort prod rollout for now. Rollback canary to previous tag and re-run CI after we re-sign artifacts.

1) abort deploy & pin to release-2026-03-13 (ff7d2a4) -> safe rollback
2) manual-approve -> force deploy (bypass signature) -> unsafe
3) wait for CI re-run after artifact re-sign (ETA ~20m)
